description: This Java class `ModifyPolicyEntryStrategy` defines a strategy for handling the `ModifyPolicyEntry` command within a policy management system. It manages validation, size checks, and event creation for modifying policy entries, including creating new entries or updating existing ones, and ensures size constraints are met before applying changes.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntryStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for handling modifications to policy entries, including validation, size checks, and event creation for updates or additions.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the modification strategy: removes the existing policy entry for the label, validates the size of the new policy and entry, and if valid, creates the appropriate event and response, handling both updates and new creations.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag associated with the previous policy entity, used for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the EntityTag for the new or modified policy entry.
